_doc: How people respond to what happens around them. 'on' maps a game happening (sent by the rules through sim.react.trigger) to a list of responses, run in order. Each response has a verb in 'do' (cover, aid, flee, firefight, defend: what the person does, coded in reactions.gd) and the numbers and texts for it. 'who' picks the people: all (everyone in the village), able (grown-ups fit to help: see 'able'), victim (the one it happened to), near (within 'reach' of the place), river (within 'reach' of a river), helpers (the nearest able people within 'reach' of the victim, at most 'count'). 'roles' limits who it applies to ('' = an ordinary villager). Texts are English translation keys. See docs/CONFIG.md.

night_watch._doc: What rouses the sleeping camp: beasts or raiders this close to the village, someone hit in a fight in the last hit_recent seconds, a flood in the last flood_recent seconds, or a force of nature (nature.alarm). The alarm lasts alarm seconds; people sleeping outdoors also wake for beasts within outdoor_beasts.
